title: Low Mach number limit and optimal time decay rates of the compressible Navier-Stokes-transport system in critical Besov spaces
summary: In this paper, we investigate the Navier-Stokes-Transport (NST) system in the framework of Besov spaces. This system contains of a compressible Navier-Stokes system for the density and momentum of a fluid, and a transport equation for the potential temperature of the fluid.
